summary: CRITICAL: run-act-tests.sh line 8 uses 'set -uo pipefail' missing -e flag (violates stated requirement). artifact-cleanup.sh lines 45, 49 use GNU date -d (not portable to macOS/BSD). Workflow lacks error handling after npm install bats (line 10) & no bats version pinning. Log-slicing awk commands (lines 89-90, 95-96) fragile to output format changes. Core script logic sound with proper validation & structure, but test harness robustness and portability issues lower score.
